prank_description: Replaced the brass pressure-gauge bezel with an engraved 'Inefficient' dial plate
summary: Hector must wrestle control from the storm while dealing with the repercussions of his own prank as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea worsens.
narrative_prose: Hector felt the deck shudder violently as the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea battered the outer hull. The sky was a bruised, sickly violet, bleeding into a bruised orange, and the howling of the wind was deafening against the strained metal. The air was thick with the scent of metallic ozone, and the sudden freezing drop in temperature bit through his insulated suit. He tasted the bitter tang of static on his tongue, a warning of the building charge. To DEFEND the primary junction, he needed to lock down the main control console, but the brass pressure-gauge bezel he had replaced just days ago stared back at him with its mocking 'Inefficient' engraving. He cursed, realizing he had to ATTRACT the magnetic grapple to stabilize the lower deck before the ferrofluid wave could CONSUME the entire section. He grabbed the heavy iron baton from the console, turning to shove it firmly into Kaio's chest. 'Take this and anchor the line!'
